place_results.title: The Biltmore Los Angeles
place_results.description: The historic Biltmore Los Angeles has been a legendary Los Angeles landmark since 1923. With exquisite Spanish-Italian Renaissance architecture, including stunning hand-painted ceilings, it's rich history is most noted for its connection with the Oscars - the founding banquet for the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences was held in the Crystal Ballroom in 1927, where the original "Oscar" statuette was sketched on a Biltmore napkin, and eight Academy Awards banquets were held in the Biltmore Bowl during the '30s and '40s.
place_results.review_snippet: This hotel is a statement of Los Angeles… glamour in its fullest.

Refined rooms and suites include flat-screen TVs and 24/7 room service. Club quarters add lounge access with free breakfast and cocktails. Our hotel in downtown Los Angeles rises 17 stories and reflects the sophistication of downtown Los Angeles, California. Iconic L.A. staples like Grand Central Market, The Broad Museum and Angels Flight Railway are just a few steps from our hotel. For sports fans, the hotel is near Dodger Stadium and STAPLES Center.

place_results.title: Philippe the Original
place_results.description: Philippe the Original opened its doors to Los Angelenos back in 1908 and is credited with inventing the French Dip Sandwich. Since the creation of the French Dip, Philippe's has served the classic dish along with popular sides including, potato salad, coleslaw, beef stew and chili. Still owned and operated by the same family since the 1920's, Philippe's celebrated their 110th Anniversary in 2018 - being the oldest continually operating restaurant in Los Angeles!

place_results.title: Los Angeles Zoo & Botanical Gardens
place_results.description: The Los Angeles Zoo is accredited by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA) and meets or exceeds the highest standard for animal care and animal health. The landmark L.A. Zoo is a world-class destination and one of the city’s top attractions. This lush 133-acre oasis is home to thousands of animals including one of the largest troops of chimpanzees in North America. Exhibit highlights include Rainforest of the Americas, which transports guests to a tropical rainforest that's home to piranhas, giant otters, harpy eagles, tapirs, and jaguars, and more. Other highlights include the new Cape vulture habitat and the LAIR (Living Amphibians, Invertebrates, and Reptiles), where guests can view rare and endangered critters, some of which can be seen at no other zoo in the world. The L.A. Zoo works with partners locally and around the globe on conservation programs geared toward creating a just and sustainable world where people and wildlife thrive, together.
